key: jeeves|head of product platform growth spend management
title: Head of Product - Platform, Growth & Spend Management
jd_excerpt:
Headquarters: United States

Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

You'll own the core Jeeves customer journey end to end: application, credit decision, onboarding, first transaction, daily spend, and the insights finance teams use to run their business. Eight connected product areas, one owner.

You'll set the strategy, own the roadmap and the outcomes, and make the trade-offs between growth, risk and cost. AI is at the core of the product, not an add-on. You'll report directly to the Chief Product Officer, with a direct line to the CEO, and lead an existing team of product managers that will grow as we expand.

Location: This role is remote based out of the United States. #LI-REMOTE

What You'll Own:

  • Onboarding: a fast, compliant application and KYB flow in every market we serve.
  • Underwriting: credit decisions, limits and limit increases, built with Risk & Credit to be fast, fair and explainable.
  • Activation: from approval to first transaction and first real value: card issuance, team invites, integrations and guided setup.
  • Spend management: controls, policies, budgets, approvals and AI-powered expense capture and coding for multi-entity, multi-currency companies.
  • Mobile: the Jeeves app for cardholders, approvers and admins, held to the quality bar of the best consumer apps.
  • Notifications: a reliable, configurable platform for real-time alerts across push, email, SMS and in-app.
  • Lifecycle communications: messaging that drives adoption, built with Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Analytics: customer-facing spend insights and reporting that finance leaders rely on every day.

The Hard Problems:

  • Underwriting a company in Mexico, Brazil or Spain in minutes, when each market has different data, credit bureaus and rules.
  • Making spend controls for a multi-entity, multi-currency company feel as simple as a consumer app.
  • Extending the platform for large enterprises without losing the speed and simplicity other customers rely on.
  • Deciding where AI should act on its own (coding expenses, setting limits) and where a person must review, and proving it with evals.
  • Choosing which finance-team problems, customer segments and markets to take on next, and making the case for each.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product teams and experience managing managers of PMs.
  • Product leadership experience building software products at a top-tier technology or fintech company (B2B fintech, payments or spend management is a plus).
  • Products shipped across multiple countries, currencies or regulatory environments.
  • Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features to production, including how to measure whether they work.
  • Strong technical product depth in back-end, API and platform products, and an experiment-driven approach to owning metrics.
  • A deep understanding of how finance teams work day to day, and how to turn their workflows into great software.
  • Clear communication and strong partnerships with Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance and go-to-market teams.

Nice to have:

  • Direct ownership of spend management, expense management or corporate card products.
  • Experience with credit underwriting, banking or risk products.
  • Experience building agentic products.
  • Experience in Latin America; Spanish and/or Portuguese fluency.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jeeves-head-of-product-platform-growth-spend-management
